problem.summary: 尽管大型多模态模型（LMM）在视觉指令调优方面取得了进展，但训练LMM的最佳方案仍不明确，不同模型在对话式推理和学术任务基准上表现不一，且缺乏系统性的设计选择研究。

motivation.summary: 为了理解LMM的能力并建立更强、更易复现的基线，需要系统地研究LLaVA框架下的设计选择，以平衡自然对话和学术任务性能，并探索开放问题如高分辨率输入、组合能力和模型幻觉。

core_idea.summary: 在LLaVA框架内，通过简单的修改（使用MLP视觉-语言连接器和添加学术任务导向的VQA数据及响应格式提示）建立更强的基线，实现数据高效和状态最先进的性能。

method.summary: 基于LLaVA框架，采用CLIP-ViT-L-336px视觉编码器和MLP投影层作为视觉-语言连接器，结合两阶段训练：视觉-语言对齐预训练和视觉指令调优。引入学术任务数据（如VQA）和响应格式提示，并通过图像分块编码扩展到高分辨率输入。

experiments.summary: 在12个基准上评估，包括学术任务导向基准（如VQAv2、GQA）和指令跟随LMM基准（如MME、MM-Vet）。进行消融研究，分析数据效率、模型选择、分辨率缩放等。

claims.claim: 1. LLaVA中的全连接视觉-语言连接器强大且数据高效。2. 简单修改（MLP连接器和学术任务数据）可建立更强基线。3. LLaVA-1.5在12个基准上达到最先进性能。4. 模型可扩展到高分辨率输入并保持数据效率。5. 存在组合能力，如多语言视觉对话。6. 数据效率高，随机下采样75%数据不会显著降低性能。

limitations.limitation: 1. 高分辨率图像训练时间延长。2. 缺乏多图像理解能力。3. 在某些领域的问题解决能力有限。4. 可能产生幻觉或传播错误信息。

nodes.title: 视觉编码器
nodes.label: Vision Encoder
nodes.summary: 使用预训练的CLIP-ViT-L-336px模型提取视觉特征。
nodes.description: 视觉编码器基于CLIP-ViT-L-14架构，输入图像分辨率调整为336x336像素，输出视觉特征图。对于高分辨率输入，采用分块编码策略。

nodes.title: 视觉-语言连接器
nodes.label: Vision-Language Connector
nodes.summary: 采用MLP投影层将视觉特征映射到语言模型嵌入空间。
nodes.description: 连接器是一个两层MLP（多层感知机），将视觉编码器的输出投影到语言模型的词嵌入维度。这替代了LLaVA中使用的单一线性层，提高了性能。

nodes.title: 训练数据混合

nodes.title: 高分辨率处理
nodes.label: High-Resolution Processing
nodes.summary: 通过图像分块编码和全局上下文拼接扩展到高分辨率输入。
nodes.description: 将输入图像分割成多个小块，每个小块独立编码为原始分辨率（224x224），然后合并特征图。拼接一个下采样图像的特征以提供全局上下文。

nodes.title: 响应格式提示
nodes.label: Response Format Prompts

nodes.description: 在训练和评估中，添加格式提示（如'Answer with the option's letter from the given choices directly'）以控制输出格式，提高在学术任务上的性能。

metadata.title: Improved Baselines with Visual Instruction Tuning
metadata.paper_type: Vision-Language / Vision-Language / Multimodal / Top-cited Computer Vision paper
metadata.abstract: Large multimodal models (LMM) have recently shown encouraging progress with visual instruction tuning. In this paper, we present the first systematic study to investigate the design choices of LMMs in a controlled setting under the LLaVA framework. We show that the fully-connected vision-language connector in LLaVA is surprisingly power-ful and data-efficient. With simple modifications to LLa VA, namely, using CLIP- ViT-L-336px with an MLP projection and adding academic-task-oriented VQA data with response formatting prompts, we establish stronger baselines that achieve state-of-the-art across 11 benchmarks. Our final 13B checkpoint uses merely 1.2M publicly available data, and finishes full training in ~ 1 day on a single 8-AI00 node. Furthermore, we present some early exploration of open problems in LMMs, including scaling to higher resolution inputs, compositional capabilities, and model hallucination, etc. We hope this makes state-of-the-art LMM research more accessible. Code and model will be publicly available.

Large multimodal models (LMM) have recently shown

encouraging progress with visual instruction tuning. In this paper, we present the first systematic study to investigate the design choices of LMMs in a controlled setting under the LLaVA framework. We show that the fully-connected vision-language connector in LLaVA is surprisingly power- ful and data-efficient. With simple modifications to LLaVA, namely, using CLIP-ViT-L-336px with an MLP projection and adding academic-task-oriented VQA data with response formatting prompts, we establish stronger baselines that achieve state-of-the-art across 11 benchmarks. Furthermore, we present some early exploration of open problems in LMMs, including scaling to higher resolution inputs, compositional capabilities, and model hallucination, etc. We hope this makes state-of-the-art LMM research more accessible. Code and model will be publicly available. 1. Introduction
Large multimodal models (LMMs) have become increas-
